Configure Map UI Controls & 9-Zone Layout Anchoring (add_control)

Source: R/controls.R
add_control.Rd

Configures built-in map controls and positions them inside glmap's 9-zone directional layout grid (x = left | center | right, y = top | center | bottom).

Usage

add_control(
  map,
  type = c("navigation", "scale", "attribution", "fullscreen", "layer_switcher", "hud",
    "toolbar", "legends", "draw", "measure", "search"),
  enabled = TRUE,
  position = "top-right",
  direction = c("vertical", "horizontal"),
  order = 10,
  collapsed = NULL
)

Arguments

map

A glmap widget or glmap_proxy.

type

Control type ("navigation", "scale", "attribution", "fullscreen", "layer_switcher", "hud", "toolbar", "legends", "draw", "measure", "search").

enabled

Logical; whether the control is enabled.

position

One of the 9 anchor positions ("top-left", "top-center", "top-right", "center-left", "center-center", "center-right", "bottom-left", "bottom-center", "bottom-right", or "topleft", "bottomright", etc.).

direction

Layout flow direction for the anchor slot: "vertical" (default) or "horizontal".

order

Numeric draw order within the anchor slot (default 10).

collapsed

Logical; for "layer_switcher", whether the panel starts collapsed as a compact button (default TRUE).

Details

Each of the 9 anchor zones ("top-left", "top-center", "top-right", "center-left", "center-center", "center-right", "bottom-left", "bottom-center", "bottom-right") automatically stacks its child controls in a configurable direction ("vertical" or "horizontal") sorted by order (lowest first), so controls, draw tools, legends, scale bar, and attribution labels never overlap!
